title: Nvidia CEO joins Trump's mission to 'open up' China
title_zh: 英伟达首席执行官加入特朗普“开放”中国的使命
summary: By Laurie Chen, Trevor Hunnicutt and Heejin Kim BEIJING/SEOUL, May 13 (Reuters) - U.S.
summary_zh: 作者：Laurie Chen、Trevor Hunnicutt 和 Heejin Kim 北京/首尔，5 月 13 日（路透社）- 美国

title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang joins Trump's China visit
title_zh: 英伟达 (Nvidia) 黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 随行特朗普访华
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has joined over a dozen U.S. CEOs on ‌President Donald Trump's visit to China this week. Trump called Huang last-minute ‌on Tuesday after seeing media coverage that he was not invited, according to one source ​familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋与十几位美国首席执行官一起参加了唐纳德·特朗普总统本周对中国的访问。据一位知情人士透露，特朗普在看到媒体报道称他没有受到邀请后，在周二最后一刻给黄蜂打了电话。

title: S&P 500, Nasdaq end lower as inflation, Iran tensions weigh
title_zh: 标普 500 指数和纳斯达克指数因通胀和伊朗紧张局势而收低

title: Trump-Xi summit: What's on the table for US, Chinese companies
title_zh: 特习会：美国和中国企业的议题
summary: President Trump is visiting Beijing this week to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping, bringing along several Big Tech CEOs like Tesla's (TSLA) Elon Musk and Apple (AAPL) chief executive Tim Cook as part of the US delegation.
summary_zh: 特朗普总统本周将访问北京，会见中国国家主席习近平，美国代表团成员包括特斯拉 (TSLA) 埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 和苹果 (AAPL) 首席执行官蒂姆·库克 (Tim Cook) 等几位大型科技公司首席执行官。

title: Altman Testifies About ‘Hair-Raising’ OpenAI Chat With Musk
title_zh: Altman 就 OpenAI 与 Musk 的“令人毛骨悚然”的对话作证
summary: (Bloomberg) -- OpenAI’s Sam Altman testified that he was “extremely uncomfortable” with Elon Musk’s insistence that he have complete control over a proposed for-profit subsidiary of the startup back in 2017.Most Read from BloombergAmbani’s Cola War With Coke, Pepsi Spurs Fridg...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——OpenAI 的萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 作证说，他对埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 在 2017 年坚称自己拥有对这家初创公司拟议的营利性子公司的完全控制权感到“极其不舒服”。

title: OpenAI's Sam Altman takes the stand in trial against Elon Musk
title_zh: OpenAI 的萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 在针对埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的审判中出庭作证
summary: OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) CEO Sam Altman took the stand on Tuesday to face questioning in the lawsuit filed by Elon Musk's attorneys over whether the AI developer breached the original non-profit mission it was founded on. Both Altman and Musk are both co-founders of OpenAI.
summary_zh: OpenAI (OPAI.PVT) 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 周二出庭，接受埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 律师提起的诉讼，质疑该人工智能开发商是否违反了其创立之初的非营利使命。奥特曼和马斯克都是 OpenAI 的联合创始人。

title: Chip stocks in focus as AI trade evolves on 'insatiable' demand
title_zh: 随着人工智能贸易因“永不满足”的需求而发展，芯片股成为焦点
summary: Yahoo Financed Tech Editor Dan Howley and Futurum CEO Daniel Newman join Asking for a Trend to discuss the chip trade and the AI trade.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经科技编辑丹·豪利 (Dan Howley) 和 Futurum 首席执行官丹尼尔·纽曼 (Daniel Newman) 加入 Asking for a Trend，讨论芯片贸易和人工智能贸易。

title: Anthropic In Talks to Raise $30 Billion at $900 Billion Valuation
title_zh: Anthropic 正在洽谈融资 300 亿美元，估值达 9000 亿美元
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Anthropic PBC is in early talks with investors to raise at least $30 billion in fresh financing, according to people familiar with the matter, setting the stage for what could be its largest funding round yet.Most Read from BloombergAmbani’s Cola War With Coke, ...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——据知情人士透露，Anthropic PBC 正在与投资者进行早期谈判，以筹集至少 300 亿美元的新融资，为可能是迄今为止最大的一轮融资奠定基础。

title: OpenAI's Altman faces questions about lying, disclosures from Musk's attorney in trial
title_zh: OpenAI 的 Altman 在审判中面临马斯克律师撒谎和披露信息的质疑
summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman faced questions related to accusations of lying and deciving the company's board as part of Elon Musk's suit againt the him.
summary_zh: OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 面临与埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 起诉的一部分有关撒谎和欺骗公司董事会的指控的质疑。
